sub_questions.question: Which task categories take the most reported hours per week for the Sales team?
How much hands-on time per week does each repeated case-based routine take in the activity log?
How many inbound emails with attachments arrive per week, by subject category, that start work?

evidence.question: Which task categories take the most reported hours per week for the Sales team?
evidence.sql: SELECT t.task_category, ROUND(SUM(t.hours) / 6.0, 2) AS hours_per_week, COUNT(DISTINCT t.person_id) AS people FROM workforce.timesheets t JOIN workforce.people p ON p.person_id = t.person_id WHERE p.team = 'Sales' GROUP BY t.task_category ORDER BY hours_per_week DESC LIMIT 8

evidence.question: How much hands-on time per week does each repeated case-based routine take in the activity log?
evidence.sql: SELECT app, action, COUNT(*) AS events, ROUND(SUM(duration_seconds) / 3600.0 / 6.0, 2) AS hours_per_week FROM workforce.task_events WHERE case_ref IS NOT NULL AND case_ref <> '' GROUP BY app, action ORDER BY hours_per_week DESC LIMIT 10

evidence.question: How many inbound emails with attachments arrive per week, by subject category, that start work?
evidence.sql: SELECT subject_category, counterparty, ROUND(COUNT(*) / 6.0, 1) AS per_week FROM workforce.email_events WHERE direction = 'inbound' AND has_attachment = 'true' GROUP BY subject_category, counterparty ORDER BY per_week DESC LIMIT 8
